text: What if all the water on Earth froze for five seconds? Bad news. Your house is about to explode.
Every pipe bursts. Ice needs nine percent more room. Your walls don't have it.
Every soda in every fridge goes off. Bang. Bang. Your fridge door just quit.
Niagara stops dead. The ocean locks up. Every ship on Earth is parked.
Every wet road is a skating rink. Good luck braking.
Your coffee is a brick. And the water inside you? Relax. I left that one alone.
Water is back. Through every broken pipe. At once.
A guy in Texas, knee deep in his kitchen, holding a fridge door. Alive. Soaked. His insurance calls it an act of God. It was me.
What should freeze next? Comments. Or I pick something worse.
